capabilities: Sync an XLSX or ODS training workbook from a cloud link
Render dashboard and today embeds for sessions
Generate day notes, workout logs and weekly reflections
Import Garmin, Google Health and FIT/TCX/GPX activities
Chart training trends and compare plans with results
disambiguation: Not a sports news or scores feed; it imports your own training workbook and watch recordings into notes.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; mobile unsupported. One active workbook plan at a time, and sync is one-way from workbook to Obsidian. Garmin integration is experimental and uses unofficial endpoints. No telemetry; a GitHub Sponsors link appears in settings.
problem: Training plans and workout results sit in spreadsheets, apart from the notes where goals, weekly reflections and progress are kept.

relations.evidence: use Calcrow for everyday Daily-sheet edits
connect under Sources → Smartwatch → Garmin to import recorded activities
Based on the Obsidian sample plugin.

requires.name: Cloud file host with an HTTPS download link (e.g. Nextcloud)

summary: Syncs an XLSX or ODS training workbook into Obsidian dashboards, calendars, workout logs and goal notes, with optional Garmin and Google Health imports.
